mapper.select: SELECT MAX(date) FROM report_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT MAX(date) FROM report_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND total > 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total_questions, COALESCE(SUM(correct), 0) AS total_correct FROM report_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_daily_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND total > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_daily_snapshot (user_id, date, total, correct, first_at, last_at, sections, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{total}, #{correct}, #{firstAt}, #{lastAt}, #{sections}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE report_daily_snapshot SET total = #{total}, correct = #{correct}, first_at = #{firstAt}, last_at = #{lastAt}, sections = #{sections}, source = #{source} WHERE id = #{id}
